verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's docs describe running models via GPU (Metal), NPU (Hexagon), or falling back to CPU, and for models too large for a device it offers offloading the whole request to its Wally cloud service rather than any local CPU+GPU hybrid offload scheme (runanywhere-docs-13, runanywhere-docs-17, runanywhere-comm-13). No evidence describes splitting a single model's layers/weights across CPU and GPU memory simultaneously to exceed VRAM limits on-device.
